sanitization.images: omitted; text/DOM/network evidence was sufficient and avoids incidental UI state

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server; qa-openai/qa-chat; stream:false; loopback-only mock
steps: POST /v1/api/chat with model qa-openai/qa-chat, one user message, and stream:false
sourceFindings.expected: Ollama response preserves the upstream assistant text `QA mock reply`.
sourceFindings.actual: Response is 200/done:true but message.content is an empty string, discarding the model reply.

sourceFindings.preconditions: browser origin http://127.0.0.1:22129; target http://127.0.0.1:22128; loopback only
steps: From a browser page on 127.0.0.1:22129, fetch each target with JSON and Authorization headers
sourceFindings.expected: Preflight includes Access-Control-Allow-Origin for the requesting loopback origin (or `*`) and the browser can issue the API request.
sourceFindings.actual: All OPTIONS return 200 with allow-methods/allow-headers but no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; all three browser fetches reject with TypeError: Failed to fetch.
sourceFindings.console: browser fetch rejection: TypeError: Failed to fetch
sourceFindings.network: OPTIONS 200; Access-Control-Allow-Origin absent on all three routes

sourceFindings.preconditions: seeded QA server with three active LLM models
steps: GET /v1/models and confirm the three seeded LLM models are listed
sourceFindings.expected: 200 OpenAI-compatible filtered list containing qa-openai/qa-chat, qa-responses/qa-response, and qa-anthropic/qa-message.
sourceFindings.actual: 404 invalid_request_error: Unknown model kind: llm; the supported-kind list omits llm.

sourceFindings.control: GET model metadata for advertised model
steps: GET /v1/models and confirm qa-openai/qa-chat is advertised
sourceFindings.expected: 200 metadata for the advertised, active model.

sourceFindings.preconditions: qa-openai/qa-chat successfully serves Gemini generateContent on the same server
steps: POST generateContent for qa-openai/qa-chat and confirm 200 QA mock reply
Search the returned model names for models/qa-openai/qa-chat
sourceFindings.expected: Gemini model discovery includes the active model that the Gemini generation endpoint accepts.
sourceFindings.actual: GET succeeds with 741 catalog entries, but models/qa-openai/qa-chat is absent.

sourceFindings.preconditions: loopback TCP request forced through non-local auth branch using non-loopback Origin; no management token
steps: GET /api/mgmt/v1/health with Origin http://qa-nonlocal.invalid and no credentials
Repeat with the ordinary gateway key, which is not a management token
Inspect response envelope and Cache-Control header
sourceFindings.expected: 401 {v:1,error} management responses also carry Cache-Control: no-store, matching management success/error contracts.
sourceFindings.actual: Both responses correctly return 401 {v:1,error}, but Cache-Control is absent.
